import re, collections

def transform(grid):
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    counts=collections.Counter(v for row in grid for v in row)
    bg=counts.most_common(1)[0][0]
    other=counts.copy(); other.pop(bg,None)
    noise=other.most_common(1)[0][0]
    pts=[(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] not in (bg,noise)]
    if not pts: return [row[:] for row in grid]
    r0=min(r for r,c in pts); r1=max(r for r,c in pts)
    c0=min(c for r,c in pts); c1=max(c for r,c in pts)
    ar=(r0+r1)//2; ac=(c0+c1)//2
    shape=[(r-ar,c-ac,grid[r][c]) for r,c in pts]
    out=[[bg]*w for _ in range(h)]
    anchors=[(ar,ac)]+[(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c]==noise]
    for rr,cc in anchors:
        for dr,dc,v in shape:
            r,c=rr+dr,cc+dc
            if 0<=r<h and 0<=c<w: out[r][c]=v
    return out

def parse_grid_block(text, label):
    m=re.search(re.escape(label)+r' \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n(.*?)(?=\n(?:Demo pair|Same instance|Wrong attempts|$))', text, re.S)
    if not m: raise ValueError(label)
    h,w=int(m.group(1)),int(m.group(2))
    rows=[[int(x) for x in line.split()] for line in m.group(3).strip().splitlines()]
    assert len(rows)==h and all(len(r)==w for r in rows),(len(rows),[len(r) for r in rows])
    return rows
for i,s in enumerate(users,1):
 inp=parse_grid_block(s,'input'); expected=parse_grid_block(s,'output')
 pred=transform(inp)
 print(i, pred==expected, sum(a!=b for ra,rb in zip(pred,expected) for a,b in zip(ra,rb)))
